summary: New York, NY, data engineer, 15 years experience in data engineering and machine learning, expertise in big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop, Redshift, Kafka, Cassandra), machine learning frameworks (scikit-learn, PyTorch, MXNet), devops (Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS), strong interest in technical leadership roles, knowledge of HITRUST, HIPAA, and PCI compliance, critical of corporate practices and management styles, advocates for employee engagement and efficient processes, skeptical of large tech companies' ethics, views on social issues and workplace dynamics reflect a progressive stance.
